<h1 id="Turc-(1961)-Temperature-Radiation-ET%E2%82%80">Turc (1961) Temperature-Radiation ET₀<a class="anchor-link" href="#Turc-(1961)-Temperature-Radiation-ET%E2%82%80">¶</a></h1><p><strong>Experiment 034</strong> — Python control baseline aligned with primal <code>science.et0_turc</code> and Rust <code>validate_turc</code>.</p>
</div>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="Theory">Theory<a class="anchor-link" href="#Theory">¶</a></h2><p>Turc estimates ET₀ from mean daily temperature and solar radiation, with a <strong>humidity correction</strong> when mean relative humidity is below 50%.</p>
<p>For $RH \geq 50\%$:
$$\mathrm{ET}_0 = 0.013 \, \frac{T}{T+15} \, (23.8846\, R_s + 50)$$</p>
<p>For $RH &lt; 50\%$, multiply by $\bigl(1 + (50 - RH)/70\bigr)$.</p>
<p>Here $T$ is mean temperature (°C), $R_s$ is solar radiation (MJ m⁻² day⁻¹), and 23.8846 converts MJ m⁻² day⁻¹ to cal cm⁻² day⁻¹.</p>
<p><strong>Citation:</strong> Turc L (1961) <em>Annales Agronomiques</em> 12:13–49.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
